source_row.stem: Standard PPE donning sequence generally begins with:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Eye protection alone, skipping the gown that should actually be the very first item put on in a proper sequence","B":"No specific donning sequence required at all, despite most facility protocols specifying a clearly defined order for putting on PPE","C":"Gown first, then mask or respirator, followed next by eye protection, with gloves being the very last item put on","D":"Gloves as the first step, leaving the hands exposed to whatever the gown and mask should have covered beforehand"}}
source_row.rationale: Standard PPE donning sequence generally begins with the gown, followed by mask/respirator, eye protection, and gloves last, which are put on immediately before patient contact.
